headerDisplay: [homebridge-myq](https://github.com/rfiorentino1/homebridge-myq) provides HomeKit support to myQ-enabled smart garage door openers. This fork uses refresh-token-only authentication (the original email/password flow no longer works due to Chamberlain gating it behind Firebase App Check in late 2023).
footerDisplay: **Bootstrap:** You must extract a refresh_token one-time from the official myQ iOS or Android app and paste it below. Once captured, it works indefinitely. See the README for extraction instructions.

name.title: Plugin Name
name.description: Name to use for Homebridge logging purposes.

refreshToken.title: myQ Refresh Token
refreshToken.description: Refresh token extracted from the official myQ app. The plugin uses this to authenticate against partner-identity.myq-cloud.com without needing App Check.

items.title: Feature Option
items.description: One option per entry. See plugin docs for valid options.

mqttTopic.title: MQTT Base Topic
mqttTopic.description: Base MQTT topic to publish to. Default: myq.

mqttUrl.title: MQTT Broker URL
mqttUrl.description: URL for MQTT broker. Default: none (MQTT disabled).

refreshInterval.title: Refresh Interval
refreshInterval.description: Normal myQ status refresh interval, in seconds. Default: 12.

activeRefreshInterval.title: Active Refresh Interval
activeRefreshInterval.description: Faster refresh interval once a state change is detected. Default: 3.

activeRefreshDuration.title: Active Refresh Duration
activeRefreshDuration.description: Duration in seconds to use the Active Refresh Interval. Default: 300.
